title: Composer goes laggy and shows the wait cursor with a large draft

steps.label: Spike in Zero.app: hardcode a definite .frame(height:) on the field and sample — does a definite height remove the CoreText path at all?
ZeroCore: heightDeterminingPrefix(of:maxLines:) pure function + ZeroCoreTests (reproduction test, option A)
Composer.swift: definite height computed from the bounded prefix
Measure rung 1 in Zero.app at 50k chars — DONE: 77%->51% busy, insufficient (<30% required); remaining cost is the WIDTH query, 765/1007 display-cycle samples
Rung 2 DROPPED — NSHostingView.minSize() is the hosting view own query, not ZeroApp.swift:32; confirmed in the real profile, ZeroApp out of scope
Probe rung 3a (.frame(width:height:)): 16->3 sizeThatFits calls but still O(draft) — REJECTED, moves the cliff
Probe rung 3b (TextEditor): worse where measurable, text never arrived where flat — REJECTED
Implement rung 3c: ComposerTextView (NSViewRepresentable over NSTextView), O(1) sizeThatFits from the bounded prefix + memo

Crash fix: SwiftUI probes the flexible child with an infinite width and Int(.infinity) trapped in sizeThatFits — the width clamp moved into ComposerMetrics.charactersPerLine(forWidth:) with a test; the unbounded probe now answers without measuring
Measure rung 3c in Zero.app at 50k chars — acceptance: <30% busy, no cellSizeForBounds: on the display-cycle path
